endorsements.name: Tim Allclair
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-1002101
endorsements.description: In Kubernetes versions 1.9.0-1.9.9, 1.10.0-1.10.5, and 1.11.0-1.11.1, user input was handled insecurely while setting up volume mounts on Windows nodes, which could lead to command line argument injection.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.0, 5.9)

endorsements.name: Tim Allclair
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-2431
endorsements.description: A security issue was discovered in Kubelet that allows pods to bypass the seccomp profile enforcement. Pods that use localhost type for seccomp profile but specify an empty profile field, are affected by this issue. In this scenario, this vulnerability allows the pod to run in unconfined (seccomp disabled) mode. This bug affects Kubelet.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.4)

endorsements.name: Tim Allclair
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0426
endorsements.description: A security issue was discovered in Kubernetes where a large number of container checkpoint requests made to the unauthenticated kubelet read-only HTTP endpoint may cause a Node Denial of Service by filling the Node's disk.
